blocks.text: Steelhead: Mission Mountain Acreages Near Stave Falls

parts.t: Steelhead is a Mission mountain and acreage community west of the city core, known for larger rural lots, forested settings, and recreational access toward Stave Falls and Hayward Lake — not a substitute for the dedicated Stave Falls waterfront market.

Buyers here typically look for year-round homes and acreages with mountain views, privacy, and outdoor lifestyle, rather than docks and primary lakefront cottages on Stave Lake. Commute and services still lean on Mission and Highway 7 access.
